title: RIALC - Repertorio informatizzato dell'antica letteratura catalana
notes: RIALC (built 1999-2003 at Naples Federico II, in collaboration with the Universities of Barcelona, UAB and Girona) is the standard digital library of medieval Catalan poetry: ~216 authors and ~1,600 13th-15th c. poems transcribed from critical editions (HTML, not TEI). The harvested texts ('RIALC: Joan de Masdovelles (~1460, 9 poems)', 'RIALC: Joan Berenguer de Masdovelles (~1460, 168 poems)', etc.) are author pages of this repertory. No explicit licence; site is live but the project is no longer actively extended. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
institution: Università degli Studi di Napoli Federico II (dir. Costanzo Di Girolamo, with Lola Badia)
